title: Capture-queue pressure past a configurable threshold
action: Per U3: config key `capture_queue_threshold` {count (default 5), days (default 7)} — validated by config validate, non-object/negative refused. When pending stubs exceed count OR oldest stub age exceeds days: the session-close capture-queue nudge escalates to overdue wording naming the breach ('N stubs pending, oldest D days — flush before new work'), and bee close's capture-queue door detail escalates the same way. Never a hard block. Below threshold: wording unchanged, byte-identical. TDD both sides of the threshold and config validation.

truths: Over-threshold queue produces overdue wording at Stop and close
